items.title: Inside Axis MF: Coffee, Market Mantras & The Road Ahead | Markets Over Coffee Ep 4
items.description:
In Episode 4 of Markets Over Coffee, we step inside Axis Mutual Fund for a candid conversation over coffee with R Sivakumar, Chief Investment Officer, and B. Gopkumar, Managing Director & CEO. From navigating market cycles and identifying opportunities to understanding where investors should focus next, this episode brings together sharp market insights and practical investing perspectives.

The conversation explores equity markets, valuations, asset allocation, long-term wealth creation, investor behaviour and the opportunities emerging across India's growth story

Get a closer look at how experienced market professionals think, analyse and make investment decisions through changing market conditions.

Grab a cup of coffee and join us for Episode 4 of Markets Over Coffee — insightful conversations, market wisdom and a look at where the smart money could be heading.
